info.title: Velora Backend API
info.description: Auth, User, Portfolio Catalog and Booking modules for the Velora home services app.

tags.name: Portfolio
tags.description: Professional work-sample catalog. Browse/search is admin-only (assignment context); upload/edit/delete stays professional self-service on their own items

tags.name: Professionals
tags.description: Professional directory and profiles - admin only; customers never browse or select a professional directly, Velora assigns one

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Image upload for portfolio covers, avatars, and booking inspiration photos

tags.name: Bookings
tags.description: Full Home Services and Individual Service booking lifecycle

tags.name: Quotations
tags.description: Quotation listing across all of the current user's bookings

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, 2FA OTP login, sessions and password management

tags.name: Categories
tags.description: Service categories and subcategories (public read; create/update/delete/image by admin)

tags.name: Quotations
tags.description: Post-consultation line-item estimate for a booking

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Secure media asset upload and management

get.summary: Get the current authenticated user's profile

put.summary: Update the current authenticated user's profile

get.summary: Get portfolio item details by id (admin only)

put.summary: Replace one of your own portfolio items (professional only)

delete.summary: Delete one of your own portfolio items (professional only, blocked while a booking still references it)
Delete an unused leaf category (admin only)

get.summary: Get the quotation for a booking (customer or assigned professional only)

put.summary: Create or update a draft quotation for a booking (professional only)

post.summary: Submit a room photo plus either structured design preferences (roomType, style, colorPalette, customColorDescription, budgetTier, features, preservation, additionalInstructions) or a legacy free-text stylePrompt; returns a job to poll (CUSTOMER). If any structured field is present, roomType, style and preservation are required. See docs/vision-api-contract.md.
Upload an image and receive a URL to reference elsewhere (any authenticated user)

get.summary: Search/browse the portfolio catalog with pagination and filters (admin only)

post.summary: Upload a new portfolio item (professional only)
Upload an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP) to cloud storage (rate-limited)
Create a category or subcategory (admin only)

get.summary: List bookings for the current user (customer sees own newest first, professional sees assigned by scheduled date). Optional repeatable status filter; actionNeeded=true (customers only) keeps active bookings whose quotation is waiting for an answer

post.summary: Create a booking - Full Home Services or Individual Service; always starts awaiting admin assignment, the customer never names a professional directly
Attach an inspiration/moodboard image to a booking (owning customer only)
Leave a review for a completed booking (customer only)
Send a draft quotation to the customer (professional only)
Verify password reset OTP and obtain a single-use reset token
Verify login OTP and receive JWT access token + refresh token
Verify the registration OTP and receive JWT access token + refresh token
Resend the email verification OTP (always returns success to prevent enumeration)
Register a new customer or professional account and dispatch an email verification OTP
Exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair
Reset password using single-use reset token and new password
Reset password using single-use reset token and new password
Change your own password (requires current password; revokes all sessions)
End this session (idempotent - an unknown token is still a success)
End every session for the current user (requires a valid access token)
Authenticate credentials and dispatch 2FA login OTP
Sign in or register with a Google ID token (customer accounts only)
Request password reset OTP (always returns success to prevent enumeration)
Request password reset OTP (always returns success to prevent enumeration)

patch.summary: Mark one of the current user's notifications as read
Set a category's image (admin only) - imageUrl is a Cloudinary URL obtained beforehand via POST /api/media/upload
Cancel a booking (customer only, before completion); the body with an optional reason may be omitted
Assign a professional to a booking awaiting assignment (admin only)
Reject a sent quotation (customer only); the body with an optional reason may be omitted

get.summary: Poll a transformation job owned by the caller (CUSTOMER)
List quotations for the current user (customer sees own, professional sees assigned)
Search/browse the professional directory with pagination and filters (admin only)

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field: averageRating, yearsExperience, fullName, createdAt

get.summary: List a professional's reviews, newest first (admin only)
List the current user's notifications, newest first
Get the current user's unread notification count
Get the status-timeline audit trail for a booking (participant or admin only)
Rank candidate professionals for a booking awaiting assignment (admin only)
Per-status booking totals for the current user, plus how many quotations await the customer's answer
List bookings awaiting professional assignment, oldest first (admin only)
